# Prep Chart

> Free, ad-free emergency preparedness charts, calculators and plain-words guides. Official and well-known sources are summarized in our own words and linked. The live site is https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/

Prep Chart compares published emergency kit lists, offers a bag-weight calculator, and charts water, food, backup power and gear. Scenario guides cover power outages, hurricanes, wildfires, winter storms and floods. The site does not cover firearms; those charts live at https://ammochart.net. General information only; not professional or medical advice. Follow local emergency officials.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/): Home hub for the charts, calculators and guides.
- [Bug-Out Bag Lists](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/bug-out-bags): Comparison of 14 published bug-out bag and 72-hour kit lists.
- [Bag Builder](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/bag-builder): Checklist and editorial weight calculator based on Ready.gov kit categories.
- [Water & Food](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/water-food): Water storage calculator, plus charts of filters, purifiers and emergency foods.
- [Backup Power](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/power): Generators, power stations and solar panels, with carbon monoxide and fuel safety.
- [Gear Charts](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/gear): Hub for six emergency gear charts.
- [Knives & Tools](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/knives): Chart of knives and multi-tools for emergency kits.
- [Fire Starters](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/fire): Chart of lighters, matches, ferro rods and tinder.
- [Shelters](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/shelters): Chart of tarps, bivies, space blankets and tents.
- [Radios](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/radios): Chart of weather radios, family radios, ham handhelds and satellite messengers.
- [First Aid Kits](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/first-aid): Chart of ready-made and DIY first aid kits, with a training reminder.
- [Headlamps](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/headlamps): Chart of headlamps by output, power source and water rating.
- [Scenarios](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/scenarios): Hub for hazard guides plus get-home and vehicle kits.
- [Power Outage](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/blackout): Plain-words power outage guide, including generator safety.
- [Hurricane](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/hurricane): Plain-words hurricane guide with official links.
- [Wildfire](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/wildfire): Plain-words wildfire guide: leave early and protect your lungs from smoke.
- [Winter Storm](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/winter-storm): Plain-words winter storm guide, including carbon monoxide and vehicle stranding.
- [Flood](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/flood): Plain-words flood guide, including Turn Around, Don't Drown.
- [Get-Home Bag](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/get-home): A light kit for walking home if normal transport stops.
- [Vehicle Kit](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/vehicle-kit): What to keep in the car for breakdowns and storms.
- [Shelf-Life Tracker](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/shelf-life): A private, in-browser expiry tracker for stored supplies.
- [Prep Styles](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/styles): A neutral description of four common preparedness styles.
- [Site Updates](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/updates): What changed on the site, newest first.

## Optional

- [sitemap.xml](https://bugoutchart.pages.dev/sitemap.xml): machine-readable list of pages.
- [SOURCES.md](https://github.com/MarcusTravis/prepchart/blob/main/SOURCES.md): per-row sources and check dates.
